deactivate_entra_user_route_api_v1_ident: Deactivating an Entra user record would lock a shared persona out of every other journey on the stack; it is exercised by identity/tests/integration/test_deactivation.py.
deactivate_service_principal_route_api_v: Deactivating the shared pipeline service principal would break the other journeys on the stack; it is exercised by identity/tests/integration/test_deactivation.py.
delete_group_registration_api_v1_identit: Deleting the shared Data Eng group registration would stop every Entra persona from being admitted; it is exercised by identity/tests/integration/test_entra_registrations.py.
enforce_platform_rule_set_version_now_ap: Enforcing a platform rule set at ROOT changes the publish gate for the whole stack and cannot be undone by a test; it is exercised by validation/tests/integration/test_semantic_rule_sets.py.
reactivate_entra_user_route_api_v1_ident: Reactivation needs a deactivated shared Entra persona first, which the e2e suite never does; it is exercised by identity/tests/integration/test_deactivation.py.
reactivate_service_principal_route_api_v: Reactivation needs the shared pipeline service principal deactivated first, which the e2e suite never does; it is exercised by identity/tests/integration/test_deactivation.py.
register_user_route_api_v1_identity_entr: The e2e suite admits Entra personas through the registered group and must keep the unregistered persona unregistered; direct registration is exercised by identity/tests/integration/test_entra_registrations.py.
reschedule_platform_rule_set_version_api: Rescheduling a platform rule set changes the publish gate for the whole stack; exercised by validation/tests/integration/test_semantic_rule_sets.py.
rotate_password_api_v1_identity_auth_pas: Exercised end to end only on a fresh stack, where the admin_password fixture rotates the bootstrap password; a warm stack reuses the stored password, and identity/tests/integration/test_login.py covers it always.
rotate_webhook_secret_route_api_v1_contr: Subscriber cards are outside the API-04 areas; issuing and rotating a webhook secret is exercised by contracts/tests/integration/test_card_webhook.py.
set_platform_rule_set_paused_api_v1_vali: Pausing a platform rule set changes the publish gate for the whole stack; exercised by validation/tests/integration/test_platform_rule_set.py and ui/e2e/platform-rule-set-controls.spec.ts.
